title.en: Beyond predicting a choice: is the decision process coherent?
title.zh-TW: 不只預測選擇：決策過程是否合理？

summary.en: My perspective on testing the factors behind a simulated preference, rather than treating a higher predicted probability as sufficient evidence of human-like behavior.
summary.zh-TW: 分享我對行為模擬的看法：應檢驗偏好背後的決策因素，而不是僅憑較高的預測機率，就認定模型的行為像真人。

title.en: Building a learning path through agentic AI
title.zh-TW: 為代理式 AI 建立清楚的學習路線

summary.en: Why I built awesome-agentic-ai-zh: connect scattered resources into a trilingual path through LLM foundations, tools, memory, evaluation, and multi-agent systems.
summary.zh-TW: 說明我為何建立 awesome-agentic-ai-zh：將零散資源串成三語學習路線，涵蓋 LLM 基礎、工具、記憶、評估與多代理系統。

title.en: Connecting research tools with Model Context Protocol
title.zh-TW: 以模型上下文協議串接科研工具

summary.en: A public account of my research-tool setup: connecting AI coding environments, literature retrieval, project files, and manuscript preparation through MCP.
summary.zh-TW: 記錄我的科研工具配置：透過 MCP 串接 AI 程式開發環境、文獻檢索、專案檔案與論文撰寫流程。
